description:
.NET Software developer/C#

Amano is looking for a dynamic software developer to join our team. If you have good C#, .NET Framework and SQL knowledge and you want to envision together with us our complex products, then we’d love you to join our team.

We develop our Amano products on Parking business where the creativity and implication from you is much appreciated. All parties (development, testing, sales, support teams, distributors) are actively providing input and contributes to product development fighting constructively for own ideas.

We do continuously new developments on our software products - the maintenance and bug fixings just a small part of our job. Our strategy is to focus more and more on cloud solutions/services and mobile applications which adds extra challenges to what we do both commercially and technically.

The job is at the office of Amano Europe Bucharest - no remote work is possible.

Required technologies:

  • C#
  • .NET Framework
  • REST Services
  • Microsoft SQL
  • Javascript/HTML/CSS (as a plus)
  • HTTP (as a plus)

What is required from you:

  • Develop software of good quality.
  • Have good communication with colleagues and external partners.
  • Be flexible in approaching your tasks.
  • Willing to learn and evolve as professional.
  • Actively participate in all aspects of software and product development.
  • Improve constantly the output of your work.
  • Solve the bugs found in the software and offer support to customers when an issue is discovered.

Benefits:

  • Attractive salary
  • Medical package
  • Meal tickets
  • Pleasant working environment. Colleagues ready to help when needed
  • Flexibility in working time
